span.span: Reasoning Content: “Let me start by auditing the current state—what’s been set up and what still needs to be done.”
The agent inspects the inherited repository, hook, web directories, Nginx configuration, and running services.
Reasoning Content: “The post-receive exists but the hook deploys to both main and dev for EVERY branch push. This is incorrect. … SSHD not running … Nginx not running.”
Main work: The agent revises the setup without deleting /git/project, then starts SSH.
Reasoning Content: “I need to create the /run/sshd directory and start sshd properly.”
Main work: The agent starts Nginx, checks the repository and hook, then tests SSH access.
Reasoning Content: “The password hash looks like it’s locked (starts with !). Let me re-set the password for gituser.”
